project_tracker_diagnostic: Distinctive long columnar brown-purple disk with drooping/reflexed yellow or maroon-and-yellow rays; leaves dissected into narrow lobes.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common and useful Central Texas field-learning taxon.

morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate, pinnatifid to deeply divided into narrow segments.
morphology_keys.heads: Disk strongly elongated/columnar, becoming tall and cylindrical; rays drooping, yellow or sometimes bicolored.
morphology_keys.fruit: Cypselae with small crownlike pappus scales.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
